name: Manchester United 2007/08
scopeNote: Manchester United 2007/08 under Alex Ferguson (Premier League and Champions League winners). Period: Community Shield 5 Aug 2007 (won on penalties v Chelsea, 'Charity Shield' in Breaking the Lines) to the Champions League final v Chelsea 21 May 2008; the league opener (v Reading) was 11 Aug 2007 if the Community Shield is not counted as competitive. Dates 5 Aug and 11 Aug are from memory and not verified in a mined page. Style term used by sources: fluid 4-4-2 / 4-2-3-1 morphing to 4-2-4 in attack with interchanging forwards (Ronaldo, Rooney, Tevez), not a fixed striker. Two corrections to the brief: Chelsea's manager in the final was Avram Grant (Queiroz was Ferguson's assistant at United, not Chelsea's coach); and no source mined describes the Barcelona or Chelsea set-up as 'Queiroz's two banks of four'. Evidence on the Barcelona tie that Hargreaves played right-back in both legs is from a search summary only (unverified). Honest label: United's pressing/zonal-vs-man marking of their own is not documented in any page read.
openQuestions: No page read states whether United defended set pieces zonally or man-to-man in 2007/08.
Hargreaves at right-back vs Barcelona (both legs) is from an inkl/Hargreaves summary only; the page returned no paragraphs, so unverified. Wikipedia lineup (11v11) not parsed.
Spielverlagerung says the squad average age was 24, which looks too low for a side with Giggs (34), Scholes (33), Van der Sar (37) and Neville; treat as dubious.

Spielverlagerung has United dominating possession in the final; Wikipedia says Barcelona had the better of the first leg and United surrendered possession in the second leg: possession depended on opponent. No hard possession percentage for the season found (Barca site claims 69% v 31% in the first leg but the page was unreadable).
Ferguson's own explanation of the Barcelona and Chelsea set-ups (primary, dated) was not found beyond the quotes recorded.
Start date: Community Shield (5 Aug 2007) counted or not; league opener 11 Aug 2007; neither date verified from a mined page.
Wes Brown podcast and Silvestre 'how Queiroz helped us beat Barcelona' pages (manutd.com) could not be read for detail on the Queiroz contribution.

Spielverlagerung says Hargreaves struggled under pressure on the right in the final, while Mancunian Matters calls the set-up perfectly validated by the opening goal: the sources differ on how well the Hargreaves/Ronaldo set-up worked.
